newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on profit taking.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to fall on Tuesday as investors reassess positions in Thai stocks accumulated following last week's baht float, analysts said.
The SET Index fell sharply lower on Monday dropping 24.06 points to 633.03 on active trade. the SET 50 index ended eown 1.89 to 47.27.
"There was a lot of irrational exuberance last week and we are going to see most of that come off this week as people take a reality check," said one foreign analyst.

Though the market sees the baht's flotation is broadly positive in the long term there are near term nerves regarding the stability of selected corporates and their levels of foreign debts, analysts said.
"The corporate side is highly volatile and people with foreign liabilities are going to have to go and buy expensive dollars soon," he said.
"With the worry that the currency could also weaken further holding Thai stocks looks risky so people have been starting to get out of the market since last Friday," he said.
